module.name: drawer
module.title: Drawer
module.description: The Drawer renderer and its options.

ui.name: drawer
ui.guidance: It is a native <dialog>, exactly like Dialog, because the platform supplies the top layer, the backdrop, the focus trap and Escape-to-close. Only the geometry differs, so a drawer that reimplemented any of that would be a second, worse dialog.
ui.keyboard: Escape closes it: this is a native <dialog>, so the platform supplies dismissal and the focus trap.
